claims.text: Role in PAH: sildenafil, tadalafil and vardenafil = oral PDE5 inhibitors (nitric oxide pathway);
claims.quote: The nitric oxide pathway is targeted by sildenafil, tadalafil, and vardenafil, which are oral phosphodiesterase 5 (PDE5) inhibitors.

claims.text: combination tx is generally preferred in groups 1 and 4.
claims.quote: With rare exception, combination therapy is generally preferred in patients with Group 1 and Group 4 pulmonary hypertension

claims.text: Sildenafil (Revatio) PAH dose: 20 mg TID; may titrate to max 80 mg TID by Sx and tolerability.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of REVATIO is 20 mg three times a day. Dose may be titrated to a maximum of 80 mg three times a day, if required, based on symptoms and tolerability

claims.text: Sildenafil CI: organic nitrates in any form (hypotension);
claims.quote: Concomitant use of organic nitrates in any form, either regularly or intermittently, because of the greater risk of hypotension

claims.text: riociguat (PDE-5 inhibitors potentiate its hypotensive effect).
claims.quote: Concomitant use of riociguat, a guanylate cyclase stimulator. Phosphodiesterase-5 (PDE-5) inhibitors, including sildenafil, may potentiate the hypotensive effects of riociguat.
Concomitant use of REVATIO with strong CYP3A inhibitors is not recommended
Concomitant use of REVATIO with moderate-to-strong CYP3A inducers (such as bosentan) decreases the sildenafil exposure.

claims.text: don't combine w Viagra or other PDE-5 inhibitors.
claims.quote: Inform patients taking REVATIO not to take VIAGRA or other PDE‑5 inhibitors.

claims.text: Sildenafil warnings: monitor BP w other BP-lowering drugs;
claims.quote: Monitor blood pressure when co‑administering blood pressure lowering drugs with REVATIO.

claims.text: seek care for sudden vision or hearing loss;
claims.quote: Hearing or visual impairment: Seek medical attention if sudden decrease or loss of vision or hearing occurs.
In the event of an erection that persists longer than 4 hours, the patient should seek immediate medical assistance.

claims.text: Sildenafil SE: headache, dyspepsia, flushing, limb pain, myalgia, back pain, diarrhea.
claims.quote: Adults: Headache, dyspepsia, flushing, pain in limb, myalgia, back pain and diarrhea.
